messages:
incident-bot: ALERT · P1 detected · inference-service-prod · high 95th/99th latency spike > 2.5s across multiple regions. auto-page oncall-sre.
incident-bot: Symptoms: request timeouts, client retries piling up. Error rate elevated (5xx). Metric links: https://metrics.internal/redwood/inference-service-prod/latency 
alex.chen: I'm jumping in. creating war room now. joining in 2m. can someone check if this correlates with deploys? :eyes:
maria.gomez: no recent deploys in the last 30m. CI bot shows last deploy 3h ago.
samir.patel: I see a pattern — tail latency spikes correlate with short tokens (~128) but also a batch size surge. maybe batching backlog.
priya.rao: war room bridge: https://zoom.us/j/999999999?pwd=ops123 (internal only) · pager link: https://pager.redwood/incidents/2951112222 · slack huddle started
alex.chen: owner: alex.chen (assigned). oncall handoff: @oncall-sre please ack and confirm whether you want a full page or keep in war room.
oncall-sre: ACK. I'm in the bridge. confirming I'm the responder. grabbing gpu-node logs now.
ops-bot: Attached snapshot: /var/log/inference/runtime/2026-03-15/latency-dump.log (snippet below)
```
[2026-03-15T14:07:02Z] req_id=abc123 model=rdw-v2 seq_len=128 latency_ms=2540 queue_ms=1800
[2026-03-15T14:07:03Z] req_id=def456 model=rdw-v2 seq_len=64 latency_ms=2700 queue_ms=2100
[2026-03-15T14:07:04Z] req_id=ghi789 model=rdw-v2 latency_ms=2600 err=timeout
```
priya.rao: quick triage notes: KV cache lookups fine. Batching queue depth has ~10x spike starting 14:06 UTC. Could be router misrouting causing many small batches to accumulate on a few GPUs.
alex.chen: immediate mitigation proposal: 1) temporarily reduce max_batch_size on rdw-v2 to 1 (fall back to synchronous path) 2) route traffic to compatible rdw-v1 fallback in us-west while we stabilize 3) scale up autoscale pools by +2 nodes for 30m
maria.gomez: drafting status page update. Suggest impact text: "We are investigating increased inference latency for a subset of API requests. Some requests may time out or experience degraded performance. We will provide updates every 15 minutes."
samir.patel: rolling config change to reduce batch size — applying to a single pool first (canary)
alex.chen: can we get a short command snippet for the canary change?
samir.patel: yes: ```
# canary reduce max_batch_size
redwoodctl rollout-config --pool gpu-pool-us-west-2 --model rdw-v2 --set max_batch_size=1 --canary 1
```
oncall-sre: executed canary. watching metrics. initial canary shows tail latency reduced from ~2.6s to ~350ms for canary shard.
priya.rao: good. initiating routing fallback to rdw-v1 for 10% of incoming requests to relieve pressure: ```
redwoodctl route-update --service inference-service-prod --add-backup-model rdw-v1 --weight 10%
```
ops-bot: status page draft (please review):
"We are currently experiencing elevated latency for Redwood Inference API (inference-service-prod) affecting a subset of requests. Some users may encounter timeouts or increased response times. Engineers are investigating; mitigations (batching config changes and partial routing to a fallback model) are underway. Next update in 15 minutes."
alex.chen: approve. post that once we have confirmation from canary that latencies improved across all pools.
maria.gomez: posted provisional status: https://status.redwood/incidents/2951112222 (update id: s-2951112222-1)
priya.rao: monitoring shows reduced queue_ms on canary pool. need to watch for error rate regressions.
oncall-sre: error rate decreased from 4.8% -> 1.1% on canary within 2m. rolling the reduced-batch-size config to remaining pools in waves of 2.
samir.patel: will also verify KV cache hotspots and slow IO on those specific nodes. grabbing dmesg and nvidia-smi snapshot.
ops-bot: Note: customer-impact classification proposed: "degraded" (not full outage) — some real-time apps may see timeouts. Recommend customer-facing notification only if we hit >10% request failures or >5 min without improvement.
alex.chen: agree. for now public status is fine. draft a short customer note we can copy to support for proactive outreach if needed.
maria.gomez: customer notification draft for support: "We’re investigating increased latency on inference requests that may affect response times. Our engineers are applying mitigations and the service is partially degraded for some customers. We will follow up with estimated ETA once stability is confirmed."
oncall-sre: rolling to all pools complete. post-rollback metrics show 95th latency back to ~220ms, 99th ~380ms. error rate down to 0.6%.
alex.chen: great work. let's keep war room open for 20 more minutes and then hand back to normal oncall for monitoring. timeline notes: started 14:06 UTC, canary change 14:12 UTC, full rollout 14:20 UTC, stability observed 14:25 UTC.
priya.rao: ops follow-up checklist: - create retro issue with timeline + root cause hypotheses - capture runbook gaps (batching thresholds, auto-route throttles) - add alert tuning for batch-queue-depth spikes
maria.gomez: status page follow-up update posted: "Mitigation applied; services returning to normal. Continued monitoring. Incident resolved for now, investigating root cause."
oncall-sre: handing to oncall monitoring: @priya.rao please take post-incident monitoring for 2h.
priya.rao: taking it. will run post-mortem template and ping infra for node-level logs.
samir.patel: quick note for retro: consider fallback-weight automation when queue_ms > X for > Y seconds.
alex.chen: thanks team. closing this thread in ~30m after final checks. if regressions appear reopen war room. :thumbsup:
